ideas.pitch: A beginner-friendly tool that scans code repositories, identifies security vulnerabilities using static analysis, and uses LLMs to generate step-by-step remediation patches along with educational security context.
ideas.title: CyberLens: AI-Powered Vulnerability Remediation Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the hackathon's focus on learning cybersecurity from zero and practicing defensive security, making it extremely appealing for beginner-focused educational tracks.

ideas.pitch: An API middleware proxy that detects and mitigates prompt injection attacks, jailbreak attempts, and data exfiltration in real-time before user prompts reach backend LLM applications.
ideas.title: PromptShield: Layered Prompt Injection Defense Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced defense-in-depth security principles to modern AI architectures, matching the technical depth seen in previous winning personal agent challenge entries.

ideas.pitch: A safe, sandboxed simulation platform that demonstrates real-world phishing and credential harvesting attacks, providing users with instant analysis on how to identify and investigate threats.
ideas.title: PhishSim: Interactive Social Engineering & Attack Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly supports the event's mission of exploring real attack and defense scenarios for beginners through practical, hands-on labs.

ideas.pitch: An automated graph-intelligence tool that maps cloud infrastructure permission sets, detects dangerous privilege escalation paths, and visualizes security misconfigurations in AWS environments.
ideas.title: AuditGraph: AWS IAM Privilege Escalation Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence and complex risk detection patterns to solve hard cloud security problems, mirroring the engineering approach of top AML platform winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted platform designed for CTF participants that parses challenge binaries or web app logs, provides progressive hinting systems, and auto-generates structured security writeups.
ideas.title: CTF-Companion: Automated Writeup & Hint Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the final live CTF competition component of the hackathon, offering immediate practical utility to fellow participants and judges alike.
